title: Amgen
summary: US biotechnology group with biologics, biosimilars and an obesity pipeline.
bodyHtml:
Investment Thesis

Amgen sells erythropoietin, immunology, oncology and bone-health biologics, and acquired Horizon to add rare-disease therapies. It is developing obesity drugs, including an injectable candidate acquired from a Chinese biotech. Patent expiries on legacy products and debt from acquisitions constrain flexibility.

Technology Exposure

  • Biologic medicines for immunology and oncology
  • Biosimilars
  • Rare disease and obesity pipeline

What To Watch

  • Obesity pipeline data
  • Patent expiries
  • Debt reduction

Record Notes

Editorial brief compiled 19 November 2026 from company disclosures, agency publications and press reporting. Figures are as reported by those sources and have not been independently audited; no live market data is used.
